items.name: permissive CORS — reflect-any-origin with credentials on /api/v1/*
items.message: Enable CORS for the JSON API
items.exact_change: New Rack::Cors middleware inserted before 0: `origins { |_source, _env| true }` (reflects ANY origin) with `credentials: true`, `headers: :any`, methods %i[get post put patch delete options head], on `resource "/api/v1/*"`. The API authenticates via the app's signed session cookie (same-origin credentials), so reflect-any-origin WITH credentials lets any website read a victim's credentialed API responses cross-origin.
